newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syrian leaders to visit Egypt for talks on Mideast.
newsitem.headline: Syrian leaders to visit Egypt for talks on Mideast.

text.p: Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam will visit Egypt on Saturday for talks with President Hosni Mubarak on developments in the Middle East peace process, officials and diplomats said on Friday.
They said Khaddam, who will be accompanied by Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara, will carry a message from President Hafez al-Assad to Mubarak.

Khaddam's visit coincides with one to Washington by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during which he had talks with President Bill Clinton on how to revive suspended Syrian-Israeli peace talks.

Syria had condemned Netanyahu for refusing to trade occupied Arab lands for peace and launched an Arab campaign to pressure the current Israeli government to change its attitude towards peace with Arabs.
Khaddam and Shara toured most Arab states during the last two weeks to rally support for Damascus' conditions for resumption of talks with Israel.
Syria says the previous Israeli government had agreed to withdraw from the Golan Heights, captured by Israel in 1967, in return for peace with Damascus.
